## **Sistem Object Detection \+ Monitoring Web**

---

## **1\. Tujuan Produk**

Membangun sistem yang mampu:

* Mendeteksi objek dari CCTV secara real-time menggunakan Python  
* Menyimpan hasil deteksi ke database  
* Menyediakan dashboard berbasis web untuk monitoring dan laporan

---


### **Komponen:**

1. **Python Detection Engine**  
   * YOLOv8 / OpenCV  
   * Input: CCTV stream (RTSP / video)  
   * Output: hasil deteksi \+ screenshot  
2. **Backend API**  
   * ASP.NET / FastAPI  
   * Menyimpan data ke database  
   * Menyediakan API ke frontend  
3. **Database**  
   * Menyimpan metadata deteksi  
4. **Web Dashboard**  
   * Monitoring live  
   * Laporan data deteksi

---

## **3\. Fitur Utama**

### **3.1 Object Detection (Python Service)**

* Input:  
  * CCTV (RTSP / IP Camera)  
* Proses:  
  * Deteksi objek (YOLO)  
  * Filtering object (opsional: hanya orang/kendaraan)  
* Output:  
  * Timestamp  
  * Object name  
  * Camera ID  
  * Screenshot path

---

### **3.2 Penyimpanan Data**

Data yang disimpan:

| Field | Tipe Data | Keterangan |
| ----- | ----- | ----- |
| id | UUID / INT | Primary key |
| timestamp | DATETIME | Waktu deteksi |
| object\_name | VARCHAR | Nama objek |
| camera\_id | VARCHAR | ID CCTV |
| image\_path | TEXT | Path gambar |
| confidence | FLOAT | Confidence score |

---

### **3.3 Live Monitoring (Web)**

* Menampilkan:  
  * Live stream CCTV  
  * Bounding box detection  
* Teknologi:  
  * WebSocket / RTSP stream convert ke HLS

---

### **3.4 Laporan (Report System)**

Fitur:

* Filter berdasarkan:  
  * Tanggal  
  * Kamera  
  * Jenis objek  
* Export:  
  * CSV / Excel  
* Statistik:  
  * Jumlah objek per hari  
  * Objek terbanyak

---

## **4\. API Design (Contoh)**

### **POST Detection Data**

POST /api/detection

Body:

{  
 "timestamp": "2026-04-22T10:00:00",  
 "object\_name": "person",  
 "camera\_id": "CAM\_01",  
 "image\_path": "/images/cam01/img123.jpg",  
 "confidence": 0.92  
}  
---

### **GET Detection Data**

GET /api/detection?start=2026-04-01\&end=2026-04-22  
---

## **5\. Flow Sistem**


### **Alur:**

1. CCTV → Python detection  
2. Object terdeteksi  
3. Screenshot diambil  
4. Data dikirim ke API  
5. API simpan ke database  
6. Web ambil data dari API  
7. User lihat live \+ laporan

---

## **6\. Struktur Project (Rekomendasi)**

### **Python Detection**

detection/  
├── main.py  
├── model/  
├── utils/  
├── output/  
│    ├── images/  
│    └── logs/  
---

### **Backend (ASP.NET)**

backend/  
├── Controllers/  
├── Services/  
├── Models/  
├── Data/  
---

### **Frontend (Vue)**

frontend/  
├── views/  
├── components/  
├── services/api.js  
---

## **7\. Non-Functional Requirements**

### **Performance**

* Delay detection \< 2 detik  
* Support minimal 2–5 CCTV simultan

### **Storage**

* Image disimpan di disk (bukan DB)  
* DB hanya simpan path

### **Scalability**

* Bisa tambah kamera tanpa ubah core system

---

## **8\. Security**

* API pakai token (JWT)  
* Validasi request dari Python service

---

## **9\. Teknologi yang Direkomendasikan**

### **Detection**

* Python \+ YOLOv8  
* OpenCV

### **Backend**

* ASP.NET Core atau FastAPI

### **Frontend**

* Vue.js

### **Database**

* PostgreSQL / SQL Server

---

## **10\. Risiko & Tantangan**

* Latency tinggi jika banyak kamera  
* Storage cepat penuh (banyak gambar)  
* Sinkronisasi real-time (WebSocket vs polling)

---

## **11\. Enhancement (Future)**

* Notifikasi (Telegram / Email)  
* Face recognition integration  
* Heatmap pergerakan objek  
* AI analytics (behavior detection)

---

## **Penutup**

PRD ini sudah cukup untuk:

* Mulai development backend  
* Integrasi Python detection  
* Bangun frontend dashboard
